summary: {person} checks whether an unfinished park project can carry its money into the next year.
realLife: Seattle’s ordinance let the parks appropriation carry forward until spent or abandoned by a later ordinance.
gates: A project with an unspent balance, a fiscal year boundary and a carryforward provision.
weights: A delayed start near year-end makes the provision consequential.
inGame: needs: unspent project balance, fiscal year, carryforward clause and any abandonment ordinance.

turns.what: Finance confirms the prior balance is available.
turns.pulledBy: The project resumes the following spring.
turns.writesBack: Charge the work to the carried appropriation.

turns.what: The project manager withdraws the spending plan.
turns.writesBack: Link the closure to the later ordinance.
